description: Na₅NiCO₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmm2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.43 Å) and two longer (2.47 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.35 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.57 Å. Ni is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Ni-O bond lengths are 1.80 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ni atom to form corner-sharing ONa₅Ni octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom.
